pairs.assumption_text: A global pandemic originated from a laboratory incident.
pairs.claim_text: There is speculation that the virus may have originated from a laboratory leak at the Wuhan Institute of Virology.

pairs.assumption_text: A single individual could transmit the virus widely under certain conditions.
pairs.claim_text: Kentucky Senator Rand Paul stated that if the SARS virus had been the cause instead of COVID, the death toll could have reached 3 to 5 million globally.
